subject: a lined sheet with a pencil whose eraser end is rubbing out one line
sourceSummary: Rewrite confusing existing documentation into clear, scannable, task-oriented prose without losing any technical fact: it first audits the current doc to catalog every problem — buried steps, undefined jargon, missing prerequisites, broken structure — and locks a clarity checklist, then rewrites the doc to fix exactly those issues while preserving every accurate instruction.
